verdict.rationale: Paperspace's official docs are hosted on docs.digitalocean.com, and a probe confirms an llms.txt file there (HTTP 200) that an agent can be pointed at. However, it is a DigitalOcean-wide index, and the evidence does not show it covers Paperspace pages; the per-page markdown variant of the Paperspace docs returned 404. Missing for 10: confirmation that llms.txt indexes Paperspace content, agent-readable markdown versions of the Paperspace docs, and hands-on or independent corroboration of agents consuming them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.digitalocean.com/llms.txt # DigitalOcean Documentation
